meta.name: caveman-commit
meta.description: Ultra-compressed commit message generator. Cuts noise from commit messages while preserving intent and reasoning. Conventional Commits format. Subject ≤50 chars, body only when "why" isn't obvious. Use when user says "write a commit", "commit message", "generate commit", "/commit", or invokes /caveman-commit. Auto-triggers when staging changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把暂存变更压缩成简洁的提交信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次写提交信息都要纠结很久
copy.tagline_en: Compress staged changes into concise commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you struggle to write clear commit messages

howto.what: 安装了此技能后，当你要求生成提交信息时，Claude 会按 Conventional Commits 格式输出简短精确的 commit message，主题不超过 50 字符，正文仅在必要时补充；它只生成文字，不会执行 git commit。
howto.when: 当你说出“write a commit”“commit message”等指令，或调用 /caveman-commit，或暂存更改有改动时自动触发。

say.text: 用 caveman-commit 给这次改动写条提交信息
say.note: Claude 会生成符合格式的简短提交信息

say.text: 为暂存的改动生成 commit message，要简短
say.note: 触发技能并遵循压缩规则

say.text: caveman-commit 停止，恢复正常提交风格
say.note: 退出该模式，恢复冗长风格

howto.what_en: When asked to generate a commit message, Claude outputs a terse, exact Conventional Commits message (subject ≤50 chars, body only when needed). It only generates text; never runs git commit.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say phrases like "write a commit" or "commit message", invoke /caveman-commit, or when changes are staged.

say_en.text: Use caveman-commit to write a commit message for this change.
say_en.note: Claude generates a short, formatted commit message.

say_en.text: Generate a terse commit message for the staged changes.
say_en.note: Triggers the skill with compression rules.

say_en.text: Stop caveman-commit and return to normal verbose commits.
